name: What is disability remodeling and what modifications does it include?

mainEntity.name: What is disability remodeling and what modifications does it include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Disability remodeling involves altering a home to make it safe, accessible, and independent for individuals with physical limitations or mobility challenges. Common modifications include widening interior doorways to clear wheelchairs, converting standard bathtubs into curbless roll-in tile showers, installing secure wall blocking for grab bars, lowering kitchen countertops, and adding entry ramps. At HH Remodeling LLC, we handle structural framing adjustments, drywall patching, and custom tile work directly, coordinating any necessary licensed plumbing or electrical relocations so the modified space remains fully functional and finished.
acceptedAnswer.description: Disability remodeling modifies living spaces for safer mobility, including barrier-free showers, widened doorways, wall grab bars, lowered counters, and wheelchair access.
